summary: Title: Blockchain finance platform Theo launches tokenized silver backed by $40 million in active leases URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/09/16/blockchain-finance-platform-theo-launches-tokenized-silver-backed-by-usd40-million-in-active-leases Published Time: 2026-09-16T14:00:00.000Z Markdown Content: 16 hrs ago 3 min read ![Image 1: Piles of gold and silver bars. (Scottsdale Mint/Unsplash)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F15706f69026b7a5f24f2bb5cb0d339cf11da391c-5760x3840.jpg%3Frect%3D0%2C300%2C5760%2C3240%26w%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) Theo brings silver leasing onchain with $50 million token launch. (Unsplash) Summary * Theo unveiled thSLVR with $40 million of silver leases committed. * The token passes lease fees paid by institutional borrowers to holders while maintaining exposure to the metal. * The product expands Theo’s commodities-financing business beyond gold and will also support its thUSD stablecoin. Onchain finance platform Theo introduced a yield-bearing tokenized silver product backed by more than $40 million of active leases, expanding its commodities-financing business beyond gold. The token, called thSLVR, gives holders exposure to silver while passing on income generated by lending the underlying metal to institutional borrowers, the New York-based company said in a Wednesday announcement. Refiners, mints and industrial manufacturers routinely borrow silver to meet production needs without assuming price risk. Those borrowers pay a lease fee and later return an equivalent amount of metal. The income has traditionally accrued to bullion banks and dealers rather than investors holding silver through exchange-traded funds (ETFs) or other products.
